remarks: Unique opportunity to own this triplex unit and let the tenants cover your mortgage. Sited on a three-acre lot and built in 2001, this Triplex style has 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms in each side unit, with an attached one car garage, along with a separate two-bedroom unit addition which serves nicely as an owner's home. Each unit has its own appointment features with an open floor plan to include Smartcore flooring throughout the main living areas. Generous room sizes and storage. A heated utility room doubles as the laundry area. Conveniently located minutes to Rte 219.  Special Conditions apply. By Appointment with minimum 48 hours advanced notice.
